theme: 教材字彙・中高階 750–850 第 50 群

items.pos: adj. 持續不斷的 | 連續的
items.colloc: continued support 持續的支持 | continued growth 持續增長
items.distinct: continuous 連續不斷的（無中斷）| continual 頻繁重複的（有間隔）
ex: The company needs continued investment to expand.
公司需要持續的投資來擴展。
We appreciate your continued support for our brand.
感謝您對我們品牌持續的支持。
This region has seen continued economic development lately.
該地區近期見證了持續的經濟發展。

items.pos: n. 信用；賒帳 | v. 把錢存入帳戶；歸功於
items.colloc: credit card 信用卡 | give credit to 歸功於
items.distinct: debit 借記；扣款 | loan 貸款
ex: The refund was credited to your account yesterday.
退款昨日已匯入您的帳戶。
She deserves credit for the project success.
專案的成功應歸功於她。
Maintaining a good credit score is very important.
維持良好的信用評分非常重要。

items.pos: v. 批評；指責；評論
items.colloc: heavily criticize 強烈批評 | publicly criticize 公開批評
items.distinct: critique 對藝術作品的專業評論 | scold 責罵（上對下）
ex: Management was criticized for the poor decision.
管理層因該決策失當而受到批評。
It is easy to criticize but hard to suggest.
批評很容易，但提出建議卻很難。
The report criticized the lack of safety measures.
報告批評了安全措施的不足。

items.pos: adj. 蓄意的；謹慎的 | v. 深思熟慮
items.colloc: deliberate attempt 蓄意嘗試 | deliberate action 謹慎的行動
items.distinct: intentional 意圖的 | spontaneous 自發的
ex: The mistake was a deliberate act of sabotage.
這次錯誤是蓄意的破壞行為。
The board deliberated on the merger for hours.
董事會針對合併案深思熟慮了數小時。
He made a deliberate choice to leave early.
他做出了謹慎的決定提早離開。

items.pos: adj. 精緻的；脆弱的；棘手的
items.colloc: delicate balance 微妙的平衡 | delicate issue 棘手的問題
items.distinct: fragile 易碎的 | subtle 微妙且難以察覺的
ex: The negotiation requires a delicate touch today.
這場談判今天需要謹慎微妙的處理。
We handled the delicate equipment with great care.
我們非常小心地處理這些精緻設備。
This is a delicate situation for the firm.
這對公司來說是一個棘手的局面。

items.pos: adj. 專注的；熱心的；忠實的
items.colloc: be devoted to 致力於 | devoted staff 忠誠的員工
items.distinct: committed 承諾投入的 | loyal 忠誠的
ex: She is devoted to improving client satisfaction levels.
她致力於提升客戶滿意度。
The team is devoted to meeting every deadline.
該團隊致力於達成每一個截止期限。
He is a devoted employee with ten years experience.
他是一位擁有十年經驗的忠實員工。

items.pos: n. 紀律；訓練 | v. 懲戒；訓練
items.colloc: self-discipline 自律 | strict discipline 嚴格的紀律
items.distinct: punishment 懲罰 | regulation 規章
ex: Employees must maintain discipline during business hours.
員工在上班時間必須遵守紀律。
The manager had to discipline the rude staff.
經理必須懲戒那位粗魯的員工。
Great success requires a high level of self-discipline.
巨大的成功需要高度的自律。

items.pos: v. 拖曳；拖延 | n. 累贅；阻力
items.colloc: drag on 拖延 | be a drag 成為阻礙
items.distinct: pull 拉 | delay 延誤
ex: The meeting dragged on for three long hours.
會議拖延了整整三個小時。
Slow systems act as a drag on productivity.
緩慢的系統會拖累工作效率。
He tried to drag the heavy box aside.
他試圖把沉重的箱子拖到一旁。

items.pos: n. 傾銷；傾倒
items.colloc: illegal dumping 非法傾倒 | anti-dumping 反傾銷
items.distinct: export 出口 | wholesale 批發
ex: The government imposed duties against cheap dumping.
政府對廉價傾銷徵收了關稅。
The factory was fined for illegal waste dumping.
工廠因非法傾倒廢棄物被罰款。
Market competition suffered due to foreign dumping.
市場競爭因外國傾銷而受損。

items.pos: n. 選舉；當選
items.colloc: general election 全面選舉 | hold an election 舉辦選舉
items.distinct: selection 挑選 | vote 投票
ex: The election results will be announced this evening.
選舉結果將於今晚公布。
Many citizens went to vote in the election.
許多市民前往投票參與選舉。
He prepared his speech for the upcoming election.
他為即將到來的選舉準備了演講稿。

items.pos: v. 遭遇；遇到 | n. 相遇；邂逅
items.colloc: encounter difficulty 遇到困難 | unexpected encounter 意外的相遇
items.distinct: face 面對 | experience 經歷
ex: We might encounter some delays in shipping today.
我們今天在運送過程中可能會遇到延誤。
Did you encounter any problems with the software?
你在使用軟體時有遇到任何問題嗎？
The manager encountered the client in the lobby.
經理在大廳遇見了那位客戶。

items.pos: adj. 令人愉快的；有趣的
items.colloc: enjoyable experience 愉快的經驗 | highly enjoyable 非常愉快的
items.distinct: pleasant 舒適的 | entertaining 有娛樂性的
ex: It was an enjoyable meeting with the partners.
這是一場與合作夥伴愉快的會議。
We aim to make work life more enjoyable.
我們致力於讓工作生活更愉快。
The business trip was surprisingly enjoyable for us.
這趟出差對我們來說出奇地愉快。

items.pos: adj. 巨大的；龐大的
items.colloc: enormous amount 巨大的數量 | enormous impact 巨大的影響
items.distinct: huge 巨大的 | vast 廣大的
ex: The project requires an enormous amount of capital.
該專案需要龐大的資本投入。
She made an enormous effort to finish early.
她為了提早完成付出了巨大的努力。
The new store had an enormous impact on sales.
新店鋪對銷售產生了巨大的影響。

items.pos: adj. 熱心的；熱情的
items.colloc: enthusiastic response 熱烈的反應 | be enthusiastic about 對...熱衷
items.distinct: passionate 熱情的（情感強烈）| energetic 有活力的
ex: We received an enthusiastic response to our proposal.
我們針對提案收到了熱烈的回應。
He is very enthusiastic about the new marketing plan.
他對於新的行銷計畫感到非常熱衷。
The staff showed enthusiastic support for the changes.
員工對這些變革展現了熱情的支持。

items.pos: v. 排除；不包括
items.colloc: exclude from 排除在外 | completely exclude 完全排除
items.distinct: remove 移除 | reject 拒絕
ex: The price does not exclude the shipping costs.
價格並不包含運費在內。
We cannot exclude the possibility of a mistake.
我們無法排除出錯的可能性。
New members were excluded from the private group.
新成員被排除在這個私人小組之外。

items.pos: v. 展示；顯示 | n. 展覽；展品
items.colloc: exhibit a talent 展現天賦 | trade exhibit 貿易展
items.distinct: display 陳列 | reveal 顯露
ex: The gallery will exhibit paintings by local artists.
畫廊將會展出當地藝術家的畫作。
He exhibits great leadership in every project.
他在每個專案中都展現了卓越的領導力。
The company will have an exhibit at the fair.
公司將在展會中設置一個展示位。

items.pos: adj. 聯邦的；聯邦制的
items.colloc: federal government 聯邦政府 | federal law 聯邦法律
items.distinct: local 當地的 | national 全國的
ex: The agency operates under federal regulations.
該機構在聯邦法規下運作。
She works for a federal office in the capital.
她在首都的一間聯邦辦公室工作。
Federal tax must be filed by the deadline.
聯邦稅必須在截止日期前申報。

items.pos: adj. 平坦的；平穩的 | adv. 直接地 | n. 公寓
items.colloc: flat rate 固定費率 | flat surface 平坦表面
items.distinct: level 水平的 | apartment 公寓（美式）
ex: We offer a flat rate for all consulting services.
我們針對所有諮詢服務提供固定費率。
Sales remained flat during the last two quarters.
過去兩季銷售額保持平穩。
The new office is located in a flat area.
新辦公室位於平坦的區域。

items.pos: adj. 逐漸的；平緩的
items.colloc: gradual increase 逐漸增加 | gradual change 逐漸的變化
items.distinct: sudden 突然的 | steady 穩定的
ex: We expect a gradual recovery of the economy.
我們預期經濟將會逐漸復甦。
There has been a gradual decline in paper use.
紙張使用量出現了逐漸下降的趨勢。
The slope provides a gradual climb to the top.
坡度提供了平緩通往頂部的路徑。

items.pos: v. 猶豫；遲疑
items.colloc: hesitate to do 猶豫去做 | without hesitation 毫不猶豫
items.distinct: delay 延遲 | wait 等待
ex: Please do not hesitate to contact our staff.
請不要猶豫，隨時聯繫我們的工作人員。
She hesitated before signing the legal contract.
她在簽署法律合約前遲疑了一下。
The client hesitated because the price was high.
客戶因為價格過高而猶豫不決。
